name: Cards
purpose: A family of container components that group related content (and optionally an action) into a bordered surface. Five types covering interactive and static use, with and without imagery.
$family: This file covers the whole Card family; each type is a separate Figma component.

variants.name: actions
variants.$nameNote: `name` is the Figma-namespace variant value (the canonical hub label). $displayName is ours (library-independent). Code-library names live in codeBindings.
variants.use: Card presenting an item with an action affordance (chevron). Content combos: icon/title/description in various pairings. Static surface (background/default).

variants.name: basic
variants.use: Interactive card (default/hover/pressed). Background shifts via tertiary/background tints on interaction. Built as a whole-card link (single tab stop).

variants.name: basic-non-interactive
variants.use: Static version of basic — no hover/pressed; background/default.

variants.name: image-with-border
variants.use: Card with an image plus headline (font-3) and optional headline link; bordered. Responsive image scales (3/5/6/7/8/9).

variants.name: image-without-border
variants.use: Image card without a border; responsive image scales.

common.arrow-icon-size: em-scaled chevron (.85em) — tracks the headline/label type size
common.arrow-padding: flex-centred (align-items:center; gap:4px) — no fixed padding tokens (legacy padding/arrow retired 2026-07-17)

build.$status: PROMOTED 2026-06-22 — gated reference is snippets/Cards.reference.html. Brought to prototype-grade 9.0/9 (board: 8 at 9/9). Build green via _build_all.py.
build.$prototypeGrade9: Added square corners (declared), a container-query reflow, the link card PRESSED state, the media headline as a real link (font-3 regular), and a 4th pattern: SELECTABLE option cards (radiogroup + roving keys, reuses the Selection-controls radio atom). The selectable variant supplies the honest keydown for AT — BAND-AID for the native-<a> gap; root-cause = decision B (see _RUBRIC-prototype-grade.md).
build.$stateContrastFixes: Dave's visual review caught state-contrast misses the gate did NOT (it only checks DECLARED pairs): dark HOVER (text/secondary 3.34 + red arrow 1.78 on #474747) and PRESSED (description 1.67 + arrow 1.15 + a dark icon on #767676). Fixed -> hover: description/arrow text/default (9.29); pressed: icon/arrow/description text/reverse (4.54). Both now declared so the gate enforces them. Root cause = the too-light dark hover surface #474747 (the parked List-items $darkFinding); systemic fix = darken that token.
build.referenceImplements: 3 of the 5 library types, chosen as the representative canonical set. The other two (basic-non-interactive, image-without-border) are documented in `variants` and derive from these (drop the interaction / drop the border).

types.content: icon (informative/card-details) + title + description + right-aligned quaternary action buttons
types.tokens: surface background/default; border border/subtle; text text/default; icon icon/default; buttons focus focus/ring

types.semantics: <a> — the whole card is one link (single focusable control, single tab stop; avoids the nested-interactive anti-pattern)
types.content: icon + arrow-link title + description; hover shifts surface to tertiary/background/hover
types.tokens: surface tertiary/background/default -> hover tertiary/background/hover; focus focus/ring; accent primary/background/default

types.content: image + headline (font-3, red arrow tip) + description + stacked arrow links
types.tokens: surface background/default; border border/subtle; description text/secondary

build.loadingState: Skeleton placeholder card (aria-busy + aria-label, pulse honours prefers-reduced-motion). Transient state, kept as <div> (not a content article).
build.reusedAtoms: Every in-card link reuses the canonical arrow-link atom from Links.reference.html (red tip, underline-on-hover, inset focus underline) — same primitive, not a custom glyph.
build.semanticsRule: Static cards (action, media) use <article>; the interactive link card is a single <a>. Required by the snippet manifest (requiredAria includes <article).
build.$resolved: NAMING (decided 2026-06-22, Dave): hub-and-spoke. The Figma node ID is the canonical identity; each variant's Figma value is its `name`; friendly labels are `$displayName`/`$aliases` (library-independent, ours); each consuming code library is a spoke in `codeBindings` with its own names. No global 'formal name' — names map through the node, never to each other. Procedure for a new library: _RUNBOOK-onboard-code-library.md.

codeBindings.$model: Hub-and-spoke. HUB = provenance.figma_node (the only library-independent identity; never renamed). Each key below is one consuming code library (a SPOKE). A library's component/variant names MAY differ from the Figma names — map them here, do not normalise. Populate from Code Connect (get_code_connect_map), never by guessing; tag unverified spokes with $status. See _RUNBOOK-onboard-code-library.md.
